profile: P8-D LibreCAD 2 entity Properties named-LTYPE selector

behavior.implementation: Expose exact names from the drawing LTYPE table; append exact current names for all selected entities when a name has no table row; set only the pen LTYPE name. The single-selection regression selects through the configured combo; the mixed-selection regression creates the row view through the property view factory and drives the real LC_PropertyViewMultiple event wrapper before selecting the missing name.
behavior.compatibility: Keep seeded canonical choices, including DASHED, and preserve pen color and width.
behavior.consumer_effect: Entity properties can display and select imported nonstandard LTYPE names without reducing existing built-in choices.

validation.selector: ./librecad_tests 'Entity properties display and change imported named linetypes,Entity properties retain a named linetype missing from the drawing table,A new drawing writes the built-in LTYPE table as before' --reporter compact
covered: Import a scratch-authored AC1027 ASCII DXF with VENDOR_BINARY and VENDOR_OTHER table rows and a VENDOR_BINARY LINE.
Property descriptor exposes DASHED and both exact imported custom names.
Create the configured entity property QComboBox, select VENDOR_OTHER by its exact item, and apply the edit, preserving color and lineweight.
Undo restores VENDOR_BINARY and redo restores VENDOR_OTHER.
Export and fresh-import; verify entity group 6 resolves to VENDOR_OTHER, the LTYPE pattern is [6,-3], and color/lineweight remain unchanged.

In a mixed selection, run the row's actual view factory and LC_PropertyViewMultiple event wrapper, select another entity's current non-table name from the created combo, and verify the selected set receives it.
validation.fixture_policy: The DXF input is generated from scratch inside the test's QTemporaryDir. No downloaded or repository fixture was added.

not_proved: The live Move/Copy GUI action delivered both false override values at its action boundary.
An edited GUI drawing preserves and visibly renders the selected custom pattern after save and fresh reopen.
Native LibreCAD_3 MPOLYGON GUI save/reopen or pinned ezdxf 1.4.5 acceptance.
